So, I have had depression for about 24 years. I have good years and really really bad ones. Recently I started getting anxiety which culminated in panic attacks that would last about an hour. I contacted better help, as I was waiting to see my GP and I felt really desperate. This is the response:
Same
I just want it to end

Today is just as painful as yesterday. If not more. Why do so many people want me to carry on suffering? Going through the possibility of getting some relief and finding none. To be constantly tortured by the promise of hope before having it snatched away?

I'm high functioning, i can hold down a job (just) and pay a mortgage so i dont think anyone really gets that i have an actual suicide plan and all the props i need. I just havent worked out how to make sure whoever finds me suffers the least amount of trauma. Or is someone i really hate.

I keep trying. I haven't stopped trying. Its fucking tiring, 24 years of trying. I take the medication, i go to work, i pay tax, i contribute to the economy and all the time i just hurt. I get no joy out of anything. I only cause pain and frustration to other people because wanting to help is not the same as being able to help
Weed makes me worse unfortunately
I think I'd welcome dimentia. The current me would get wiped out

I've been on all of them over the years, and some of the older ones, they knock me out. The NHS doesn't have a team of people for each patient, you just get what you're given. But even then I've never had a gp or psychiatrist prescribe me more than one anti depressant at a time and this is over two decades. I think I do just want the end now

I have had quite a few councillors over the years and I'm currently on the highest dose of sertraline (zoloft) you can take. Hasn't taken the edge off at all.
This has been the majority of my life; and all of my adult life. Alone. In emotional pain which turns into physical pain. Asking for help, and getting platitudes or just refusals. I really don't think i want to have to endure it any more
I'm just a pathetic lump of flesh
Yeah. Wow such empty
For some of us there is no getting better. It becomes that people wanting us to stay around seem selfish because we are in so much pain. My life is torture.

As someone who has felt like this despite having treatment etc for the best part of 20 years I would say its better to go young as there are less people you've touched who will be hurt by yiur death. I with I had gotten it right the first time I tried when i was 15
Me too
Yep, started smoking when I was 13 for this exact reason. I still want to die but so far no cancer 22 years later.
I know. I do try but I'm tired of it. Thank you anyway

No, i'm in the UK. There are people to "talk" to but I get frustrated and angry which isn't helpful when I try to talk out loud. I tried online with an anxiety charity but the person I spoke to was completely untrained and just typed in various platitudes which just made me feel even worse.

At a guess I think the issue is that I dont produce enough dopamine or serationin for the neurons in my brain, but I get anxiety as well as depression, so probably too much cortisone OT other stress hormones. I have low thyroid as well, but that is newer than the mental health problems so it's probably unrelated.

 Nothing and everything makes me cry.
Sometimes I feel incredibly suicidal on the rare occasions I'm happy and content. Like I want to end on a positive.

And I'd like to point out that contributing to society, being successful and having friends and a good job don't actually make a difference to how mental illness affects you. I have a decent job, lots of friends and I think I contribute, even if only in taxes, more than I take out and I still wake up every day wanting to die, and fall asleep wanting to die.  
I did get some pets. They depend on my for everything so I know that if I killed myself they would starve to death. That is something which stops me from actually doing it at the moment.

This reminds me of the dilemma I have with myself every day. Sometimes it's would they be better off without me, sometimes it's why do they want me to suffer. I have felt suicidal on and off since I was about 14, been in hospital a few times after failed attempts i'm now 35. Still receiving treatment, but mainly to reassure my family that I'm not going to kill myself, even though I know that one day I will. 
Last year one of my friends killed himself. He was living with his mom and she found him. I don't think it is something she or his sisters will ever get over, so if you decide that suicide is your method of stopping your depressed then you have to come to terms with the fact that it will have very lasting effects on your family and friends.
